subject: Wolf
status: local generated candidate; independent visual acceptance pending

calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one static transparent full-body combat sprite for Warwrit, B001 Wolf.
Primary request: create one ordinary adult grey-brown wolf, credible natural anatomy, narrow chest, dense coarse rough fur and a low-carried head. It is dangerous natural fauna, not a supernatural beast. Four anatomically correct legs with all four paws visible and grounded in an alert, low balanced stance; recognizable canine muzzle, two ordinary ears and one natural bushy tail carried low. No snarling fantasy exaggeration.
Input images and roles: image 1 unit-c-ink.png is the approved ink rendering, contour and wash style only, not a human subject; image 2 staraya-melnitsa.png is subdued palette and grounded material/light direction reference only, not background; image 3 battle-ux-v3.png is approved elevated three-quarter battlefield projection and readable creature scale reference only; image 4 night-mill-beast-concept-v2.png is dark coarse-fur ink/hatching and shadow-mass reference only, DO NOT copy its monster anatomy, giant claws, glowing eyes or posture.
Style/medium: serious grounded dark fantasy ink illustration; irregular dark ink contours, restrained internal hatching, flat matte washes and strong soot shadow masses. Coarse fur locks with slate-grey, soot, weathered umber and muted grey-brown variation. Natural dark eyes, natural wolf paws and claws; no glow.
Composition: isolated single complete wolf, fixed elevated three-quarter view visibly looking down at the wolf's back and paws. Body runs from rear at screen lower-left toward muzzle at screen upper-right, facing screen upper-right. Keep the head low at shoulder level and show the far legs with plausible separation. Full muzzle, ears, tail, all four feet fully inside canvas with generous transparent margins on every side. Readable clean silhouette when scaled relative to an 80px-high human.
Lighting: upper-left light, soft restrained highlights on top and left fur, strong shaded underside; do not mirror baked lighting.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside wolf. No ground tile, terrain patch, pedestal, contact shadow, backdrop, border, words, watermark, equipment, symbols, other objects or other creatures. No painted cast shadow below paws.
Avoid: cute rounded proportions, cartoon face, glossy 3D render, photographic fur, pristine pale coat, vivid colors, magic, monster claws, invented lore, extra limbs or cropped body.
